summary: Lufax Holding Ltd filed a Form 6-K furnishing its monthly return for equity issuer movements under Hong Kong Exchange Listing Rules. This is a routine regulatory filing of a foreign private issuer and does not describe any special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or abrupt management change. The filing merely reports monthly securities movements and is compliance-oriented.
